answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, split across independent auditors, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. By the orchard of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the comet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the zephyr of the next round. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
